results.title: Monitor Arm Clamp Reinforcement Guide
description: A reinforcement plate can spread clamp contact over a larger area on a suitable desktop. It does not certify glass, repair a hollow core, or increase an arm's load rating. Verify the desktop manufacturer's mounting permission, the arm's clamp dimensions, and the complete thickness of the top plus plates before buying.
